FlareSolverr.description:
FlareSolverr is a proxy server to bypass Cloudflare protection, needed by Prowlarr for some torrent sites. See the FlareSolverr guide for setup information.

Note: This rock-on runs as root.

Note: If you will use FlareSolverr with Prowlarr, make sure both are in the same Docker network after installation.

Based on the official OCI image, available for amd64 and arm64 architecture.

LOG_HTML.description: Set to true only for debugging to log HTML that passes through the proxy.
LOG_HTML.label: HTML logging [e.g. false]

LOG_LEVEL.description: Set the log verbosity. Valid values include info, debug, warn, and error.
LOG_LEVEL.label: Log level [e.g. info]
